name: CISC-16
description: RISC-16's opposite: every arithmetic instruction can reach memory, through six addressing modes written into the mnemonic (ADD_RX R0, R6, -1 is R0 = R0 + [R6 - 1]), one instruction copies memory to memory, and ENTER and LEAVE build stack frames for recursion.
tagline: Six addressing modes on every instruction

programs.name: Sum a table
programs.description: Immediate, absolute and post-increment operands: ADD_RP R0, R1 adds the next cell and steps on

programs.name: Copy a string
programs.description: MOV_PP R2, R1 copies a character memory to memory and steps both pointers: a loop body in one instruction

programs.name: Recursive Fibonacci
programs.description: fib(n) calls itself twice; ENTER, LEAVE and an indexed local keep every call's values in its own stack frame

programs.name: Code is data
programs.description: The program rewrites its own instructions: ADD_XI R1, 1, 1 changes the letter OUT_I prints, and MOV_AA copies a HLT over the first instruction
